question: What chapter of the Aṃśumatkāśyapa concludes with this deposit rite?
premises: The text is identified as Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
The section concerns the womb deposit rite.
inference: This concludes the twenty-fifth chapter on the womb deposit rite in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, on the rite of the womb deposit, in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
